text: Patients can book an appointment.
Doctors can view patient records.
Nurses can update a patient's chart.
Patients can cancel an appointment.
The clinic staff can print invoices.
Students can enroll in a course.
Teachers can upload assignments.
Students can submit homework online.
Teachers can grade submitted assignments.
Parents can view their child's attendance.
Customers can transfer money between accounts.
Customers can download monthly statements.
Bank staff can freeze an account.
The system shall send a confirmation email after each booking.
The app sends a reminder before each appointment.
Drivers can accept a delivery request.
Drivers can mark a delivery as completed.
Dispatchers can assign a route to a driver.
Members can reserve a book.
Librarians can add new books to the catalogue.
Members can renew a borrowed book.
Employees can apply for leave.
Managers can approve leave requests.
Guests can check in using a QR code.
Hotel staff can assign a room to a guest.
Users can filter results by date.
Users can share a document with a colleague.
Users must not edit a locked document.
Tenants can pay rent through the portal.
The system must calculate the total fee for each student.
Pages must load in under 2 seconds.
The search results must appear within 1 second.
The system must support 5000 concurrent users.
The server must respond to each request within 200 milliseconds.
Reports should be generated quickly even with large amounts of data.
All passwords must be stored in encrypted form.
All traffic must use HTTPS.
Patient records must be accessible only to authorised staff.
Sessions must expire after 15 minutes of inactivity.
The system must protect personal data against unauthorised access.
The interface must be easy to use for first-time users.
New users should be able to learn the application within one hour.
The application must be accessible to users with visual impairments.
The layout must adapt to mobile phone screens.
Error messages must be clear and easy to understand.
The system must be available 99.9% of the time.
The service must recover from a server failure within 5 minutes.
Data must be backed up every night.
The application must continue working if one server fails.
The website should be available at all times.
The code must follow the company coding standards.
New modules should be easy to add without changing existing code.
The system should be easy to maintain.
The application must run on Windows and Linux.
All modules must have automated unit tests.
